item.title: From CloudFormation to Diagrams: Automating Architecture Documentation
item.description: You’re explaining your serverless architecture to a new team member at 2 PM on a Monday. You pull up the architecture diagram from Confluence, walk them through the API Gateway, Lambda functions, DynamoDB tables, and SNS topics. They nod along, asking good questions. Then they clone the repo, open the CloudFormation template, and immediately notice: “Wait, this diagram shows 3 Lambda functions but the template has 7. And where’s this SQS queue in the diagram?”
